objects.description: [SUNSPOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0562) used Windows API functions such as MoveFileEx and NtQueryInformationProcess as part of the [SUNBURST](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0559) injection process.(Citation: CrowdStrike SUNSPOT Implant January 2021)
